description: This file defines the NotesSyncWorker class which extends CoroutineWorker. It handles synchronizing notes when network connectivity is available, by invoking the repository's syncNow() method in a background coroutine worker. It is part of the data synchronization component of an Android app.

classes.name: NotesSyncWorker
classes.description: A worker class that performs background synchronization of notes when invoked by WorkManager.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Overrides CoroutineWorker.doWork to perform the sync operation; returns Result.success() if successful, or Result.retry() in case of an exception.
